messages.author: 059ecb6cdd9d9d13
messages.subject: Hide the legend
parts:
Hi,

I am drawing a simple scatter plot with fill assigned to some factor.
E.g.
mtcars$cyl <- ordered(mtcars$cyl)
mtcars %>% ggvis(~mpg, ~wt, fill = ~cyl) %>% layer_points()

Is there a way to hide the legend from the plot?

Thanks &  best regards,
   Alexey
